**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear, good [old slave](../persons.html#113),
How nice and kind and understanding your letter was, and how thankful one should be for such friends! ...

The worst will be over when we hear from [Julian](../persons.html#1624), poor boy!

Till then it seems like bearing the first stroke.

But I am sure it fell mercifully as far as we were concerned, and the flow of feelings that meet us from all is very gratifying.
I believe [my uncle](../persons.html#1614), always living in his own town far off, had no notion of the estimation in which his brother was held.
. . . I know I shall miss [him](../persons.html#1631) more when he has been away longer.
